title: The Yogurt Pot behind the Milk
youtube_title: The Yogurt Pot behind the Milk | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Some good things arrive only when they are not poked.
summary: At a greenhouse bench with seed pots and a south window, Noemi wants to check on a yogurt pot tucked behind the milk before it is ready. With Auntie June nearby, Noemi leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
